translation: (Voiceover/Aalapana): Kaloji, a ray of light in the Telugu home, he is Jabali, the seeker of truth...

Pallavi (Chorus): Kaloji, a ray of light in the Telugu home, is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he (he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth); anna.. Kalanna of Telangana's battle cries proclaimed freedom and equality to the world (proclaimed freedom and equality to the world.. proclaimed freedom and equality to the world)

Verse 1: All the sorrow of the destitute welled up in his eyes (all the sorrow of the destitute welled up in his eyes); the great flames of the people's movement came into his hands (the great flames of the people's movement came into his hands); a garland of letters full of ideals that stirs heart after heart; Kaloji, a ray of light in the Telugu home, is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he (he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth)

Verse 2: A life that moved by non-violence, a journey against inequality (a life that moved by non-violence, a journey against inequality); resistance that drives out cowardice was his straight path (resistance that drives out cowardice was his straight path); a righteous war against the state and its many kinds of violence; Kaloji, a ray of light in the Telugu home, is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he (he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth)

Verse 3: In 'Naa Godava', the people's sayings, the idioms of saying no (in 'Naa Godava', the people's sayings, the idioms of saying no); the man who would never say 'Ji Huzoor', who says 'ji' only to courage (the man who would never say 'Ji Huzoor', who says 'ji' only to courage); a flag of wise, sensible words, in form a mountain for the destitute; Kaloji, a ray of light in the Telugu home, is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he (he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth is he.. a Jabali who searches for the truth)

Verse 4: The form of the Buddha as a wandering monk, the twilight raga of struggle (the form of the Buddha as a wandering monk, the twilight raga of struggle); Marxism, born from the womb of time, is the path to follow (Marxism, born from the womb of time, is the path to follow); a song of liberation in every land, a prophecy that wakes us up; you of the blazing, searing gaze, Kalanna, you burned like the sun within us (you burned like the sun within us); anna, you with a full and generous heart, Kalanna, you showered on us like full moonlight (you showered on us like full moonlight); anna, salutes, salutes to you, Kalanna, red, red salutes to you, Kalanna (red, red salutes to you, Kalanna); anna, Telangana's salutes to you, Kalanna, accept the homage of the Telugu home, anna (accept the homage of the Telugu home, anna)

He spread through the Telugu home as a ray of light.. he rang out as Telangana's battle cry (he.. rang out as Telangana's battle cry.. he.. rang out as Telangana's battle cry.. he.. rang out as Telangana's battle cry)
summaryEn: Telunginti Velugu Rekha ('A Ray of Light in the Telugu Home') is a tribute song sung by Vimalakka on the album Vimalakka Hits (2023). It honours Kaloji, whom the singer affectionately calls 'Kalanna' (elder brother Kaloji): this is the Telangana poet Kaloji Narayana Rao, whose best-known collection, 'Naa Godava' ('My Protest'), is named in the third verse. The chorus calls him a ray of light in every Telugu home and compares him to Jabali, a sage remembered for his fearless search for truth. He is the voice of 'Telangana's battle cries', proclaiming freedom and equality. The verses build a portrait of a poet of the people. The sorrow of the poor welled up in his eyes. He walked a non-violent path against inequality, yet treated resistance to cowardice as the straight road. He waged a 'righteous war' against the violence of the state. He never said 'Ji Huzoor' to power, and he spoke the people's own idioms of refusal. The fourth verse sets the Buddha as a wandering monk beside Marxism as 'the path to follow', and then moves into direct address, offering him 'red, red salutes' from Telangana and the homage of the Telugu home. The song ends on the image of Kaloji ringing out as Telangana's battle cry.
summaryTe: ‘తెలుగింటి వెలుగు రేఖ’ విమలక్క 2023 ‘విమలక్క హిట్స్’ ఆల్బమ్‌లో పాడిన నివాళి గీతం. గాయని ‘కాళన్న’ అని ఆత్మీయంగా పిలిచే తెలంగాణ ప్రజాకవి కాళోజీ నారాయణరావుకు ఈ పాట అంకితం; మూడో చరణంలో ఆయన ప్రసిద్ధ కవితా సంకలనం ‘నా గొడవ’ పేరు కూడా వస్తుంది. పల్లవి ఆయనను తెలుగింటి వెలుగు రేఖగా, నిర్భయంగా సత్యాన్ని శోధించిన జాబాలి వంటివాడిగా, స్వేచ్ఛా సమానతలను లోకానికి చాటిన తెలంగాణ పొలికేకగా కీర్తిస్తుంది. చరణాలు ప్రజాకవి చిత్రాన్ని నిర్మిస్తాయి: నిరుపేదల దుఃఖం ఆయన కన్నుల్లో పొంగింది; అహింసా మార్గంలో అసమానతలకు ఎదురు నడిచినా, పిరికితనాన్ని తరిమే ప్రతిఘటనే ఆయన రుజుమార్గం; హింసాత్మక రాజ్యంపై ధర్మయుద్ధం చేశారు; అధికారానికి ‘జీ హుజూర్’ అనలేదు, ప్రజల నానుడులను, ‘నకారాల’ నుడికారాన్ని పలికారు. నాలుగో చరణం బుద్ధుని పరివ్రాజక రూపాన్ని, ‘అనుసరణీయమైన’ మార్క్సిజాన్ని పక్కపక్కనే నిలిపి, తర్వాత నేరుగా ఆయనను సంబోధిస్తూ ‘ఎర్రెర్రని దండాలు’, తెలంగాణ దండాలు, తెలుగింటి వందనాలు అర్పిస్తుంది. ప్రతి పంక్తి బ్రాకెట్లలో మళ్ళీ రావడం ప్రధాన గాయని-బృందగానం పద్ధతిని సూచిస్తుంది. కాళోజీ తెలంగాణ పొలికేకగా మోగాడనే చిత్రంతో పాట ముగుస్తుంది.
